no_building.name: getting the most out of the land
no_building.note: The shared fallback of every menu (governor-agendas.md section 3): nothing on the menu was taken, so the town works its ground harder. +10% yield on every tile it works, while it stands.

expeditions.name: gathering a lean expedition
expeditions.note: Go wide's (founding-towns.md section 2, governor-agendas.md section 6). Gathers for gathers_months, then takes takes_share of the people and of the gold, and everything of wood, stone, tools and food above the town's normal reserve.

expeditions.name: gathering a thick expedition
expeditions.note: Go tall's. The same, later and larger.
